full_judgment: 4. On the basis of the report submitted by the Inspection team, respondent No. 2 issued a demand-cum-show cause notice dated 3-4-2016 asking the petitioner why it should not be held liable for punishment under section 156(1), Table Clauses 1, 51, 51A, 61 and 90 for violation of sections 86, 97, 144 and section 13(1) of the Customs Act, 1969. On receipt of the said notice, the petitioner submitted a objection on 12-5-2016 refuting the allegations made in the said show cause notice. Upon conclusion of hearing, respondent No. 2 passed the Adjudication Order No. 242/Bond Circle-06/2017 dated 11-6-2017, imposing a penalty of Taka 1,00,000 in addition to the customs duty and taxes amounting to Taka 1,02,86,435.19, thereby totaling Taka 1,03,86,435.19.
